summary: J.Jill, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 5, 2026 reporting the results of its 2026 annual meeting held June 3, 2026. Stockholders elected two Class III directors (Michael Rahamim and Mary Ellen Coyne) and ratified Grant Thornton LLP as the independent auditor. Additionally, the board reduced its size to seven members following the retirement of Andrew Rolfe. These actions are routine corporate governance matters and do not constitute a special situation event as defined by the classification criteria. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformative event.
